skills.name: 一、二、三……
skills.desc:
普攻
进行最多4段的连续攻击，造成气动伤害。
施放普攻第4段后进入解读状态，持续5秒，若切换至其他角色则该效果提前结束。
若西格莉卡至少拥有50点【句点】，普攻从第2段开始。

普攻·明悟
处于解读状态时，地面短按普攻施放普攻·明悟，造成气动伤害，本次伤害为声骸技能伤害。
施放时退出解读状态。

重击
消耗耐力攻击目标，造成气动伤害。
施放重击后的一段时间内，短按普攻施放普攻第2段。

空中攻击
消耗耐力进行空中下落攻击，造成气动伤害。
施放空中下落攻击后的一段时间内，短按普攻施放普攻第2段。

闪避反击
在地面成功闪避后一定时间内短按普攻，将会攻击目标，造成气动伤害。
施放闪避反击后的一段时间内，短按普攻施放普攻第4段。

闪避反击·解读
处于解读状态时，在地面成功闪避后一定时间内短按普攻，将会施放闪避反击·解读，攻击目标，造成气动伤害，本次伤害为声骸技能伤害。
施放时退出解读状态。

空中闪避反击
在空中成功闪避后一定时间内短按普攻，将会攻击目标，造成气动伤害。
施放空中闪避反击后的一段时间内，短按普攻施放普攻第2段。
skills.descEn:
Basic Attack
Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Aero DMG.
Enter the Decipher state for 5s after casting Basic Attack Stage 4. This effect ends early if Sigrika is switched off the field.
When Sigrika has at least 50 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=1} of Full Stop, her Basic Attack cycle starts from Stage 2.

Basic Attack - Elucidated
While in the Decipher state, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack on the ground to cast Basic Attack - Elucidated, dealing Aero DMG (considered Echo Skill DMG).
Leave the Decipher state upon casting this skill.

Heavy Attack
Consume STA to attack the target, dealing Aero DMG.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after casting Heavy Attack to cast Basic Attack Stage 2.

Mid-air Attack
Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing Aero DMG.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after casting Plunging Attack to cast Basic Attack Stage 2.

Dodge Counter
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge on the ground to attack the target, dealing Aero DMG.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after casting Dodge Counter to cast Basic Attack Stage 4.

Dodge Counter - Decipher
While in the Decipher state, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge on the ground to cast Dodge Counter - Decipher to attack the target, dealing Aero DMG (considered Echo Skill DMG).
Leave the Decipher state upon casting this skill.

Mid-air Dodge Counter
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge in mid-air to attack the target, dealing Aero DMG.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after casting Mid-air Dodge Counter to cast Basic Attack Stage 2.

skills.name: 罗伊近身格斗技
skills.desc:
嘭嘭！
攻击目标，造成气动伤害。
施放嘭嘭！后的一段时间内，短按普攻施放普攻第3段。

大嘭嘭！
处于解读状态时，地面短按共鸣技能可施放大嘭嘭！，造成气动伤害，本次伤害为声骸技能伤害。
施放时退出解读状态。

日灵帮帮忙
处于解读状态时，若西格莉卡至少拥有50点【句点】，地面短按共鸣技能可施放日灵帮帮忙，造成气动伤害，本次伤害为声骸技能伤害。 
施放时退出解读状态。
skills.descEn:
BOOMY BOOM!
Attack the target, dealing Aero DMG.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after casting BOOMY BOOM! to cast Basic Attack Stage 3.

BIG BOOMY BOOM!
While in the Decipher state, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Resonance Skill on the ground to cast BIG BOOMY BOOM!, dealing Aero DMG (considered Echo Skill DMG).
Leave the Decipher state upon casting this skill.

Soliskin to the Aid
While in the Decipher state, with at least 50 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=0} of Full Stop, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Resonance Skill on the ground to cast Soliskin to the Aid, dealing Aero DMG (considered Echo Skill DMG).
Leave the Decipher state upon casting this skill.

skills.name: 如那期望般！
skills.desc:
造成气动伤害，本次伤害为声骸技能伤害。西格莉卡获得专注，持续20秒。

专注
西格莉卡下一次获取【符文】时，可额外获取一枚不同的【符文】，并移除专注。
西格莉卡同时拥有专注和回声时，回声优先生效。
西格莉卡【句点】为100点时，专注不生效。

Divergent

When Sigrika holds Divergent and Convergent at the same time, Convergent takes priority.
When Sigrika holds 100 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=1} of Full Stop, Divergent doesn't take effect.

回声
西格莉卡下一次获取【符文】时，可额外获取一枚相同的【符文】，并移除回声。
西格莉卡同时拥有专注和回声时，回声优先生效。
西格莉卡【句点】为100点时，回声不生效。
skills.descEn:
Casting Intro Skill - Solsworn Etymology grants Convergent for 20s.

Convergent
The next time Sigrika obtains a Rune, she additionally obtains a Rune of the same type and removes Convergent.
When Sigrika holds Divergent and Convergent at the same time, Convergent takes priority.
When Sigrika holds 100 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=1} of Full Stop, Convergent doesn't take effect.

skills.name: 语义共鸣
skills.desc:
队伍中的角色施放声骸技能时，西格莉卡为自身叠加一层语义的祝福，最多叠加6层，同名声骸仅可触发一次该效果。
角色编入队伍时，重置该效果。 

语义的祝福
每层语义的祝福使队伍中登场角色气动伤害加成提升3%，声骸技能伤害加成提升3%。
语义的祝福达到6层时，西格莉卡的气动伤害加成和声骸技能伤害加成额外提升30%。

西格莉卡自身的共鸣效率大于125%时，每超过1%的共鸣效率使自身声骸技能伤害加成提升2%，上限50%。
skills.descEn:
When any nearby Resonators in the team cast Echo Skill, Sigrika gains a stack of Blessing of Runes, up to 6 stacks. Echoes with the same name can only trigger this effect once. 
This effect resets upon a lineup change.

Blessing of Runes
Each stack of Blessing of Runes grants the active Resonator in the team 3% Aero DMG Bonus and 3% Echo Skill DMG Bonus.
When Blessing of Runes reaches 6 stacks, Sigrika additionally gains 30% Aero DMG Bonus and Echo Skill DMG Bonus.

For every 1% of Sigrika's Energy Regen over 125%, Sigrika gains 2% Echo Skill DMG Bonus for up to 50%.

skills.name: 在那浩瀚中
skills.desc:
重击·符语本源
长按普攻，施放重击·符语本源，造成气动伤害并消耗两枚【符文】。根据消耗的【符文】类型，获得以下效果：
·若消耗【符文】为一枚【符文·期望】和一枚【符文·答问】，追加符语爆破效果。
·若消耗【符文】为两枚【符文·期望】，追加符语链刃效果。
·若消耗【符文】为两枚【符文·答问】，追加符语日灵效果。
消耗【符文】时，若【日灵能量】不少于30点，消耗30点【日灵能量】，本次符语爆破、符语链刃和符语日灵伤害倍率提升50%，并为自身叠加一层「天赋？」。
消耗【符文】时，若【日灵能量】少于30点，消耗全部【日灵能量】，每消耗10点【日灵能量】，使得本次符语爆破、符语链刃和符语日灵造成的伤害加深15%。
重击·符语本源造成的伤害为声骸技能伤害。

符语爆破
造成气动伤害，本次伤害为声骸技能伤害。

符语链刃
停滞附近目标，造成气动伤害，本次伤害为声骸技能伤害。

符语日灵
牵引附近目标，造成气动伤害，本次伤害为声骸技能伤害。

共鸣回路·我即语义
【句点】为100点时，若共鸣回路·我即语义不处于冷却状态，共鸣技能·嘭嘭！和共鸣技能·日灵帮帮忙改为短按并松开时施放，长按共鸣技能消耗全部【句点】可施放共鸣回路·我即语义，造成气动伤害，本次伤害为声骸技能伤害。

「天赋？」
「天赋？」可叠加的层数上限为2层，每层可以使得西格莉卡符语爆破、符语链刃、符语日灵和共鸣回路·我即语义伤害加深30%。
西格莉卡施放共鸣回路·我即语义后或切换至其他角色该效果结束。

【符文】获取规则
【符文】累积上限4枚，未拥有【句点】时仅可累积2枚，达上限时再次获取【符文】，已有【符文】将左移一格，最左侧的【符文】将被移除。拥有50点【句点】后可继续累积2枚【符文】。
施放普攻·明悟或闪避反击·解读期间，普攻·明悟或闪避反击·解读命中目标时，可获取一枚【符文·期望】。
施放共鸣技能·大嘭嘭！或共鸣技能·日灵帮帮忙期间，共鸣技能·大嘭嘭！或共鸣技能·日灵帮帮忙命中目标时，可获取一枚【符文·答问】。

【句点】获取规则
施放重击·符语本源后可以获得50点【句点】，上限100点。

【日灵能量】获取规则
附近队伍中所有角色施放声骸技能时，西格莉卡可以获得10点【日灵能量】，上限60点，同名声骸仅可触发一次该效果。施放延奏技能·在这一瞬间时，重置同名声骸记录。
skills.descEn:
Heavy Attack - Schemata of Runes
Hold Normal Attack to consume two Runes and cast Heavy Attack - Schemata of Runes, dealing Aero DMG. Based on the types of the Runes consumed, Sigrika gains the following effects:
- When consuming Rune: Trust and Rune: Answer, this skill gains the effect of Runic Outburst.
- When consuming two Runes: Trust, this skill gains the effect of Runic Chain Whip.
- When consuming two Runes: Answer, this skill gains the effect of Runic Soliskin.
When consuming Runes, if Sigrika holds at least 30 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=0} of Soliskin Vitality, consume 30 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=1} to increase the DMG Multipliers of the current Runic Outburst, Runic Chain Whip, and Runic Soliskin by 50%. Obtain a stack of Innate Gift?.
When consuming Runes, if Soliskin Vitality is lower than 30 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=3}, consume all Soliskin Vitality. Every 10 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=4} of Soliskin Vitality consumed grants the current Runic Outburst, Runic Chain Whip, and Runic Soliskin 15% DMG Amplification.
Heavy Attack - Schemata of Runes deals Echo Skill DMG.

Runic Outburst
Deal Aero DMG (considered Echo Skill DMG).

Runic Chain Whip
Stagnate nearby targets and deal Aero DMG (considered Echo Skill DMG).

Runic Soliskin
Pull in nearby targets and deal Aero DMG (considered Echo Skill DMG).

Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name
When Full Stop reaches 100 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=6}, if Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name is not on Cooldown, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Resonance Skill to cast Resonance Skill - BOOMY BOOM! or Resonance Skill - Soliskin to the Aid. Hold Resonance Skill to consume all Full Stop to cast Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name, dealing Aero DMG (considered Echo Skill DMG).

Innate Gift?
Sigrika can hold up to 2 {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=7} of Innate Gift?. Each stack grants Runic Outburst, Runic Chain Whip, Runic Soliskin and Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name 30% DMG Amplification.
This effect ends after Sigrika casts Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name or is switched off the field.

Rune
Sigrika holds up to 4 {Cus:Sap,S=Rune P=Runes SapTag=9}. Without Full Stop, Sigrika can only hold up to 2 {Cus:Sap,S=Rune P=Runes SapTag=A}. When Sigrika gains a new Rune at max capacity, the existing Runes shift one slot to the left, removing the leftmost Rune. With at least 50 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=B} of Full Stop, Sigrika can hold 2 additional {Cus:Sap,S=Rune P=Runes SapTag=C}.
Hitting a target directly with Basic Attack - Elucidated or Dodge Counter - Decipher in the duration of the moves grants one Rune: Trust.
Hitting a target directly with Resonance Skill - BIG BOOMY BOOM! or Resonance Skill - Soliskin to the Aid in the duration of the moves grants one Rune: Answer.

Full Stop
After casting Heavy Attack - Schemata of Runes, gain 50 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=D} of Full Stop, up to 100 points.

Soliskin Vitality
When any nearby Resonators in the team cast Echo Skill, Sigrika gains 10 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=E} of Soliskin Vitality, up to 60 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=F}. Echoes with the same name can only trigger this effect once. Casting Outro Skill - In This Very Moment resets the record of Echo triggering this effect.

Innate Gift? now stacks up to 4 times and is no longer removed after Sigrika casts Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name or is switched off the field.
When not in combat, all Innate Gift? stacks are removed every 30s.

chains.name: 失去着，收获着
chains.desc: 队伍中的角色施放声骸技能时，使队伍中的角色攻击提升20%，持续20秒。
chains.descEn: When a Resonator in the team casts Echo Skill, all Resonators in the team gain an 20% ATK increase for 20s.

chains.name: 直到沉于影下
chains.desc: 共鸣解放如那期望般！伤害倍率提升30%。
chains.descEn: The DMG Multiplier of Resonance Liberation Where Trust Leads Me! is increased by 30%.

chains.name: 语义点亮，光芒升起
chains.nameEn: True Names Resurfaced, Rising in Light
chains.desc:
目标受到西格莉卡的伤害提升30%。
「天赋？」获得下述额外效果：
·每层使得西格莉卡符语爆破、符语链刃、符语日灵和共鸣回路·我即语义造成的伤害加深15%，至多使造成的伤害加深60%。
·每层使得西格莉卡符语爆破、符语链刃、符语日灵和共鸣回路·我即语义造成的伤害无视目标7.5%防御，至多使造成的伤害无视目标30%防御。
chains.descEn:
Targets take 30% more DMG from Sigrika.
Innate Gift? gains following effects:
- Each stack additionally grants Runic Outburst, Runic Chain Whip, Runic Soliskin, and Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name 15% DMG Amplification, up to 60%.
- Each stack causes Runic Outburst, Runic Chain Whip, Runic Soliskin, and Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name to ignore 7.5% of the target's DEF when dealing damage, up to 30%.
